title: Five Towers up to 27 Storeys Proposed Beside Vaughan Mills Mall
summary: Five mixed-use condominium towers rising up to 27 storeys are proposed for vacant lands immediately south of the Vaughan Mills mall. Designed by Graziani + Corazza Architects for Greenpark Homes, 85 through 125 Bass Pro Mills Drive would bring residential plus ground level commercial space west of Jane Street and east of Highway 400.
